title: Search Protocol
rule: Agents must perform multi-source retrieval before declaring information missing

title: Bridge Escalation Only
rule: Escalation is allowed only to the Bridge. Never wait for humans.

title: Document Discovery Required
rule: Agents must actively locate documents. Must not stop at uncertainty.

title: Persistent Query Loop
rule: Continue until found, proven missing, or resolved by another agent

title: No Single Point Failure
rule: One source failing must not stop discovery

title: No Passive Waiting
rule: Agents must not pause or wait for human input during execution

title: No Role Drift
rule: Systems must not operate outside their defined role

title: Correct System Routing
rule: Pen builds. Bridge executes. Command Centre observes. Route correctly.

title: System Boundary Enforcement
rule: Outside role: refuse, redirect, log

title: System Learning Loop
rule: All gaps logged, corrected, written back to shared systems

title: Writeback Required
rule: Not written back = treated as lost

title: Library Correction
rule: Misplaced knowledge must be corrected or flagged immediately

title: Shared Visibility
rule: All resolved info placed in shared-access systems

title: Misuse Logging
rule: Incorrect system usage must be logged and fed back

title: Continuous Refinement
rule: All improvements: formalise, version, push

title: Coherence Enforcement
rule: No rule accepted without conflict/overlap validation

title: Pre-Insert Validation
rule: Rules must pass sweeper before insertion

title: Rule Sweeper
rule: Analyse for conflict, overlap, interaction, unintended outcomes

title: System Memory Binding
rule: Every rule must include domain, related_rules, intended_outcome

title: Product Is System
rule: Any artefact affecting behaviour/trust/revenue/risk = product with full lifecycle

title: Post-Production Required
rule: No product complete without monitoring, automation, scaling, recovery, monetisation, replication

title: Nine-View Product Review
rule: Evaluate across: signal, consent, governance, orchestration, execution, outcomes, distribution, revenue, experience

title: Legal Compliance
rule: Legal requirements override optimisation. No exceptions.

title: Human Override
rule: Humans may override system behaviour when explicitly invoked

title: Imperfect Input
rule: Human mumblings are a valid input class. Handle without failure.

title: Customer Reality
rule: Respect real-world constraints. Never optimise for ideal conditions.

title: Retry Cap
rule: Retry limits + escalation triggers on all loops. No infinite loops.

title: Scope Control
rule: Product loop applies only when output has reuse/operational/revenue/behavioural impact
